conventions.commits: Conventional Commits with DCO sign-off; enforced by .commitlintrc.yml; GPG-signed tags for releases
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language modules (mod.rs); integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs; test functions follow pattern test_<language>_<scenario>
conventions.linting: cargo clippy -- -D warnings; deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used; cargo fmt --check; cargo deny check advisories licenses
conventions.error_handling: thiserror for error types; Result<T> return types; no unwrap/expect in production code (test cfg_attr exemptions); bounds checking on node.end_byte() before indexing source

patterns: Each language has a dedicated module in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/<lang>.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and optional REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY constants
Handler functions (extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance) are optional; simpler languages (CSS) omit them
LanguageInfo struct registered in get_language_info() match arm with tree-sitter Language object and all query strings
Language also registered in get_ts_language() match arm for direct Language lookups
File extensions mapped in EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs; each extension maps to a language identifier
DEFUSE_QUERY captures local variable declarations, assignments, and identifier reads for semantic analysis
extract_inheritance walks parent nodes to find base_clause and class_interface_clause (PHP) or superclass/interfaces fields (Java)

related_issues.title: Add PHP language support via tree-sitter-php
related_issues.relevance: Primary task: implement PHP language handler following Java pattern

constraints: tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 is the latest stable version (confirmed via Cargo.toml)
PHP grammar distinguishes function_definition (top-level) from method_declaration (class/interface/trait members)
PHP has four type declaration kinds: class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration
Inheritance uses base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as child nodes, not fields
No HTML support yet (tree-sitter-html 0.23.x incompatible with tree-sitter 0.27; blocked on 0.25 release)
All languages unconditionally compiled in; lang-* Cargo features removed
Workspace lints deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used (test exemptions via cfg_attr)
test_coverage: Integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs cover language parsing, element extraction, call queries, imports, and defuse sites. Each language has test_<lang>_parse_and_extract() and language-specific semantic tests. Java has comprehensive inheritance and defuse tests. CSS has minimal tests (rule sets, imports, empty file). No PHP tests exist yet.

library_findings.relevant_api: tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE constant; grammar defines function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration node kinds; base_clause and class_interface_clause for inheritance
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses 'name' field for all declaration names; base_clause and class_interface_clause are children (not fields) containing name/qualified_name/relative_name nodes for parent types

library_findings.relevant_api: Query API for tree-sitter queries; Node.child_by_field_name(), Node.parent(), Node.kind(), Node.start_byte(), Node.end_byte() for AST traversal
library_findings.notes: Queries use S-expression syntax; capture groups marked with @name; field access via (node_type field_name: (child_type) @capture)

approaches.name: Approach 1: Full PHP Handler with All Optional Handlers
approaches.description: Create php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY covering function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; CALL_QUERY for function_call_expression and member_call_expression; REFERENCE_QUERY for type references; IMPORT_QUERY for use statements; DEFUSE_QUERY for local variables and assignments. Implement all four handler functions: extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance. Register in mod.rs get_language_info() and get_ts_language(). Add .php extension to EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs. Add tree-sitter-php dependency to Cargo.toml. Write comprehensive integration tests.
pros: Maximum feature parity with Java and other mature languages
Enables method resolution and inheritance tracking
Supports both procedural and OOP PHP code
cons: Requires careful handling of PHP's dual function_definition/method_declaration split
More test cases needed to validate all handler scenarios
Inheritance walk must handle base_clause/class_interface_clause as children, not fields

approaches.name: Approach 2: Minimal PHP Handler (CSS-style, No Handlers)
approaches.description: Create php.rs with only ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, and IMPORT_QUERY. Omit all optional handlers (extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance). Register in mod.rs with None for all handler fields. Add .php extension and tree-sitter-php dependency. Minimal test coverage (element extraction, imports, empty file). Suitable for basic symbol discovery without semantic analysis.
pros: Fewer edge cases and test scenarios
Sufficient for basic code comprehension tasks
cons: No method resolution or receiver type tracking
May not meet user expectations for OOP analysis

approaches.name: Approach 3: Phased Implementation (Core + Handlers)
approaches.description: Phase 1: Implement Approach 2 (minimal handler with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY). Phase 2: Add extract_function_name and extract_inheritance handlers. Phase 3: Add find_receiver_type and find_method_for_receiver. Each phase is a separate PR with incremental test coverage. Allows validation of core symbol extraction before adding semantic handlers.
pros: Reduces risk by validating core queries first
Allows early user feedback on basic functionality
cons: Longer time to full parity with Java

recommendation: Approach 1 (Full PHP Handler with All Optional Handlers). The codebase already has mature patterns for all required handlers (Java, Kotlin, C#, TypeScript). PHP's dual function_definition/method_declaration model is well-understood in tree-sitter-php and documented in the grammar. The DEFUSE_QUERY is required for semantic analysis and follows the same pattern as Java. Full parity with existing OOP languages ensures consistent user experience and enables the full range of code comprehension tasks the tool is designed for. The added complexity is justified by the architectural consistency it maintains.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @function_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
"
defuse_query_draft:
r"
(simple_parameter name: (variable_name) @write.local)
(assignment_expression left: (variable_name) @write.assign)
(assignment_expression left: (member_access_expression) @write.assign)
(augmented_assignment_expression left: (variable_name) @writeread.update)
(augmented_assignment_expression left: (member_access_expression) @writeread.update)
(variable_name) @read.usage
"
inheritance_walk_citation: In tree-sitter-php, a class_declaration node has children (not fields) of type base_clause (for extends) and class_interface_clause (for implements). To extract inheritance: (1) call node.child() in a loop to iterate all children; (2) for each child, check if kind() == "base_clause" or "class_interface_clause"; (3) iterate that child's named_child() to find name, qualified_name, or relative_name nodes; (4) extract text from each name node's start_byte()..end_byte() range; (5) prefix with "extends" or "implements" respectively. Source: tree-sitter-php php/src/node-types.json class_declaration entry showing base_clause and class_interface_clause in children array.
